entries.english:
1292, 13 January. — Hedwig von Schaumberg, widow of Wok von Rosenberg, transfers her rights to the church of Strobnitz to Hohenfurt Abbey.

XLIII. I, Hedwig, called von Schaumberg, formerly the wife of the late Lord Wok von Rosenberg, wish by these present letters to make known for testimony to all present and future that I have transferred to the brethren of my foundation, the Cistercian monastery called Hohenfurt, the church at Strobnitz, whose right of patronage in one half, together with other appurtenances, I received from my beloved husband, the aforementioned Lord Wok, Marshal of the Kingdom of Bohemia, in connection with the marriage by which I was joined to him. I have transferred that church alone, with all my rights, so that the abbots of the aforesaid monastery may hold it perpetually with their brethren and confer it as they see fit.

In testimony of this, I have authenticated this present document with my seal. Given in the year of the Lord 1292, on the eighth day after the Epiphany of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Seal: A small damaged seal in white wax hanging from a parchment strip, showing two clasped hands and a peacock on each side. Millauer, p. 109, no. 25.
